description: Java class implementing native interface for serial port communication with methods for opening, configuring, and controlling serial ports, including native method declarations.

classes.name: SerialNativeInterface
classes.description: Java class providing native methods to interact with serial ports across different operating systems, encapsulating port control, data transfer, and event handling functionalities.

methods.name: getNativeLibraryVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the native serial port library, useful for ensuring compatibility.

methods.name: openPort
methods.description: Opens a serial port with the specified name, returning a handle or -1 on failure.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Configures port parameters such as baud rate, data bits, stop bits, parity, and initial control line states.

methods.name: purgePort
methods.description: Purges the input/output buffers of the port based on specified flags.

methods.name: setEventsMask
methods.description: Sets the event mask for monitoring specific serial port events.

methods.name: waitEvents
methods.description: Waits for serial port events and returns information about occurred events.

methods.name: setRTS
methods.description: Sets the state of the RTS control line.

methods.name: setDTR
methods.description: Sets the state of the DTR control line.

methods.name: readBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the port.

methods.name: getBuffersBytesCount
methods.description: Returns counts of bytes in input and output buffers.

methods.name: setFlowControlMode
methods.description: Sets the flow control mode for the port.

methods.name: getFlowControlMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current flow control mode.

methods.name: getLinesStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of control lines like CTS, DSR, RING, and RLSD.

methods.name: sendBreak
methods.description: Sends a break signal for a specified duration.
